name.description: The name of the OTS instance.

description.description: A brief description of the OTS instance.

accessed_by.description: The network limitation for accessing the OTS instance. Valid values: Any, Vpc, ConsoleOrVpc.

instance_type.description: The type of the OTS instance. Valid values: Capacity, HighPerformance.

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the OTS instance.

table_name.description: The table name of the OTS instance.

primary_keys.description: List of primary key definitions for the table.

time_to_live.description: The retention time of data stored in this table (unit: second). -1 means never expired.

max_version.description: The maximum number of versions stored in this table.

deviation_cell_version_in_sec.description: The max version offset of the table.

attach_vpc.description: Whether to attach a VPC to the OTS instance.

vpc_name.description: The name of the VPC being attached to the OTS instance.

vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch being attached to the OTS instance.
